unit: MiB = 1,048,576 bytes; PowerShell 1MB divisor is binary MiB

definitions.heap: Current usage/capacity/external usage summed once per application isolate group, without forced GC. Before is before action setup; after follows the profile frame-delivery drain. Snapshot timestamps within that sampling call are not recorded.
definitions.phaseRss: ProcessInfo.currentRss start/end plus an in-process 250 ms Timer sampled maximum. Event-loop delays can delay samples; this is not an exact peak. This timer differs from the separate 250 ms frame-delivery drain.
definitions.csvWorkingSet: Windows Process.WorkingSet64 / 1MB from the external nominal 500 ms sampler. Includes the whole application process, native/runtime/profiling state.
definitions.csvPrivate: Windows Process.PrivateMemorySize64 / 1MB, private committed process memory; not equivalent to resident working set or Dart heap.
definitions.csvWindow: Exact root PID plus creation ticks and launchIndex, startMs <= epoch_ms < endMs. No halo/nearest sample or interpolation. Per-action observed maxima are summarized with equal action weights where available.

limitations: No allocation-throughput, retained-object, live-object-after-GC or exact process peak claim.
Heap differences and deltas include natural GC timing, prior action history and instrumentation; negative deltas are retained.
Long open is a partial-load state; steady_scroll follows verified full load of one million logical lines and no active content I/O.
Open actions shorter than the external sampler interval may have no in-window CSV sample; absence is not zero and coverage differs by side.
Repeated actions share process state. Four paired process medians describe one VM, not independent hardware replications.
All raw observations are retained. Do not pool runs or attribute the whole-PR comparison solely to representation.
